articleTitle: Electronic Radar Signal Recognition Based on Wavelet Transform and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In modern warfare, radar signals are becoming more and more complex. How to quickly and accurately obtain the category information of target tracks from various radar detection data with huge amount of data, and provide accurate and effective information for battlefield command is an urgent problem to be solved at present. With the development of wavelet theory, the application of wavelet transform is more and more extensive. In the training stage, the image is decomposed by stationary wavelet with scale 2 using the proposed algorithm, and then the high and low frequency components are respectively input into five designed residual networks for training. In the testing stage, inverse wavelet transform is used to obtain the final predicted image. Firstly, nine kinds of LPI radar signals are subjected to Choi-Williams distribution (CWD) time-frequency transformation to obtain two-dimensional time-frequency images. Then, the time-frequency images are denoised by denoised convolutional neural network. Finally, the images are sent to Incident-v4 network for feature extraction and classified by softmax classifier, so as to realize effective classification and identification of LPI radar signals. Convolution using a large number of analog datasets based on 4 typical LPI radar signals (Linear Frequency Modulation (LFM), Nonlinear Frequency Modulation (NLFM), Biphase Coded Signal (BPSK), COSTAS Frequency Coded signal) and white noise signals The neural network model is trained, and a small amount of measured signals (LFM, BPSK) are added as the verification set for adaptation, so as to better fit the detection model of the measured signals. Combining the classic and recent main techniques of radar signal processing, this paper discusses the value and potential of wavelet transform as a new and effective time-frequency analysis tool applied to wavelet transform and convolutional neural network in electronic radar signal recognition.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning Methods for Estimation Soil Bulk Density
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Accurate assessment of regional soil bulk density is a key process to understand the role of soil organic carbon in the global carbon cycle. Using the second national soil survey data of China, this study applied three machine learning methods: random forest model, artificial neural network, and support vector machine model, to estimate the soil bulk density. The results show that the correlation between soil bulk density and soil organic matter is the best, and its correlation coefficient is greater than 0.5. Among the three estimation models, the random forest model has the highest prediction accuracy, with a coefficient of determination R2 of 0. 53, RMSE of 0. 1471g/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, and SDPE of 0.1475g/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. In order to reduce the contingency of data division, a 10-fold cross-validation was performed on each model. The results showed that the RMSE and SDPE of the random forest model were the smallest, and the overall trend of MPE was closest to 0, and the model fitting effect was good. According to the soil data of this study, using the soil pedotransfer functions (PTFs) published in China to predict the soil bulk density, in the estimation results, the prediction accuracy and model fitting effect are not as good as machine learning methods. The estimation of soil bulk density based on machine learning methods is generally close to the actual value, indicating that machine learning methods can be applied to soil bulk density estimation.

articleTitle: Design of license plate recognition system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In recent years, with the improvement of people's living standards, the number of vehicles is also increasing, and the effective management and identification of vehicles has a very important practical significance. To quickly identify and manage the vehicles, this paper has designed a license plate recognition system based on the field programmable logic gate array. By setting the binarization threshold, the license plate image binarization, the license plate information from the image, using the horizontal vertical projection method statistics the license plate information pixel statistics, separate the characters from the license plate information, then through the digital feature identification algorithm, and then the statistical results and character matching, so as to identify the specific content of the license plate. Experiments show that the system frame processing speed is 65fps, which can meet the real-time requirements, while the license plate recognition accuracy is 96.2%, with a low false alarm rate.

articleTitle: Low carbon and economic operation of integrated energy system considering electricity-thermal flexible load
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In the context of energy transition and the goal of “peak carbon and carbon neutrality”, it is of great significance to build an integrated energy system that can simultaneously take into account the economy and low carbon of electric energy production. Firstly, a model of electric-thermal flexible load is established considering the flexible energy use characteristics and regulation effects of electric-thermal load; secondly, the carbon trading mechanism and over-emission penalty mechanism are introduced into the system dispatching model to establish a low-carbon dispatching model of integrated energy system; finally, the low-carbon economic dispatching model of integrated energy system based on electric-thermal flexible load is proposed with the lowest total system operation cost as the goal, and the calculation results show that, compared with the traditional linear modeling and cogeneration energy supply method, the proposed optimization model and strategy can be effective. The results show that the proposed optimization model and strategy can effectively reduce the operating cost and carbon emission, and have higher economic and environmental protection.

articleTitle: A Delay-based Interest Packet Forwarding Strategy in Vehicular Named Data Networking
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The network topology is constantly changing in the Internet of Vehicles (IoV), and the frequent disconnection and connection of nodes in the network affect the successful transmission of data. To separate data from the host at the network layer and ensure data transmission, Vehicular Named Data Networking (VNDN) was recently proposed for the advantages of content communication. However, the use of flooding mechanism in VNDN can easily cause congestion in wireless channels with limited bandwidth. To alleviate the network congestion problem, the existing research has proposed a few solutions in which the optimal nodes undertake the forwarding task, whereas additional communication is still needed to update neighbouring node information. In order to reduce useless forwarding without additional overhead, this paper proposes a forwarding strategy of interest packets to alleviate congestion, in which the data forwarding process of shorter-distance nodes is postponed and cancelled by the introduction of a carefully designed artificial delay. Compared with other strategies in simulation, the scheme has a balanced hit ratio and delay, and network overhead is greatly reduced.

articleTitle: Visual Communication Design of Image Multidimensional Visualization Fusion System Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the advent of the era of big data, people are exposed to a variety of data information every day. With the rise of high technology in the computer industry, data models are becoming more and more complex and changeable. Therefore, it is necessary to combine visualization technology with machine learning technology to process data more efficiently. With the development of computer processing software and related technologies, computer image processing software is widely used in modern film and television, advertising, games, software, and commercial activities for image design and visual communication design. The works designed by this design method have strong appeal and clear features, which can easily leave a deep impression on the viewer. At the same time, the art works designed by this design method are more innovative, which also has positive and profound significance for creators. However, most researchers currently focus on the optimization of the machine learning algorithm itself, but ignore the visual communication design of the image multi-dimensional visualization fusion system based on machine learning, and cannot intuitively see the operation process of the design. Therefore, this article focuses on the analysis of the current state of research in the field of visualization related to machine learning technology.

articleTitle: Research on Obstacle Avoidance Strategy of Grid Workspace Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper proposes a multi-agent autonomous obstacle avoidance method based on the deep learning method. This method is used in grid workspace with strict position and motion constraints. The whole process uses Continuous Lidar data as the environment description to generate actions, and guides the agent to learn excellent strategies by continuously performing actions in the environment to obtain rewards. Based on the Proximal Policy Optimization(PPO) algorithm, we improved the design of the reward function, introduced density reward, distance reward and step penalty, which reduced the occurrence of congestion and improved the task efficiency of the agent. Finally, we conducted experiments in the simulation environment. Compared with the previous distributed methods, our method has smaller redundant paths and higher success rate of task completion. Compared with centralized methods, our method has advantages in terms of computational complexity, which can guarantee short planning times in large-scale environments.

articleTitle: Performance Comparisons of Machine-Learning-Based Intrusion Detection Algorithms through KDD Dataset
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With tremendous data volume generated by various types of devices, the Internet faces a serious challenge in network security. As one of the primary countermeasures, IDS (Intrusion Detection System) has been widely used for the identification of suspicious flows; however, it lacks enough flexibility, adaptability and generalization capability for new attacks. Recently, ML (Machine Learning) has been widely discussed for application in IDS, and a number of works have proven its superiority in traffic classification, though with different sorts of algorithms. Thus, to further check their performance, in this paper, we perform extensive simulations with several representative ML-based intrusion detection algorithms evaluated through the KDD dataset, including LR (Logistic Regression), DT (Decision Tree), RF (Random Forest), NB (Naive Bayes), SVM (Support Vector Machine), and DNN (Deep Neural Network), where key indicators contain Precision, Recall, Accuracy, F1-Score and Training time. The corresponding results show that RF is more efficient for its relatively high detection accuracy with low complexity. In addition, we think ensemble learning and deep learning have the potential to perform better in detecting attacks.

articleTitle: Database Interface Application Based on ODBC Development
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In this paper, the structure and application principle of ODBC and the basic method and idea of developing data application program based on ODBC are described in detail. Combined with a concrete example, this paper describes how to develop the simulation software of the dual channel amplitude ratio direction finder, and introduces in detail the link between the application program of the simulation software and the database, the concrete realization of the main button and the realization of key technologies. From the development of the program, the application of ODBC development applications, high development efficiency, strong compatibility, short development cycle, low cost, easy to achieve. It has strong operability and practicability and is widely used in small simulation software.

Author Keywords: dual channel specific amplitude method direction finder

articleTitle: Fast Intra Mode Decision Algorithm of HEVC Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Aiming at the high complexity and large amount of computation of HEVC intra mode decision algorithm, a fast intra mode decision algorithm based on convolutional neural network is proposed. Firstly, different size of prediction units are scaled to the same size through bilinear interpolation, and then sent to convolution neural network to perform convolution pooling and other operations. Finally, the mode decision results are selected by softmax layer. Five standard test sequences with different resolutions are used to form data sets, and the convolutional neural network model is trained and tested. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is equivalent to the standard test software HM16.0 in image quality and video bit rate, but the total coding time is improved by about 20.14%.

articleTitle: Research on Course Score Analysis Based on K-Means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Traditional data analysis methods can no longer meet the current demand for course score analysis. Clustering analysis is a traditional and famous data mining tool. With the rapid development of education informatization, it's inevitable that the data mining technology is applied in the education field. The principle and process of the K-means clustering algorithm is described in this paper. And evaluates and analyzes the course scores of a college based on the K-means clustering analysis algorithm, and provides a reference for teachers and students. Based on the results of cluster analysis: For teachers, hierarchical teaching and personalized guidance strategies can be adopted to implement “precise” teaching of course knowledge points. For students, they can understand their mastery of the various knowledge points of the course, and adjust their time and energy in a targeted manner to improve learning efficiency.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent quilt based on single chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In order to realize the temperature of the quilt, it can be adjusted locally in real time so that the temperature of the quilt is always at the optimum temperature, And real-time monitoring and analysis of the user's vital signs data, If the analysis finds that the user's vital sign data is abnormal, it can automatically alarm the function. This paper designs a 51 single-chip microcomputer as the main control, Combined with temperature sensor, Heart rate blood oxygen sensor, Semiconductor refrigeration/heater and WIFI wireless communication mode, An intelligent quilt system is designed. The system is controlled by STC89C52RC chip, and receives body temperature data through DS18B20 temperature sensor. Heating or cooling through semiconductor chips, bring it to the preset temperature. At the same time, the heart rate is collected through the heart rate and blood oxygen measurement module, vital signs data such as blood oxygen and degrees, and upload the data to the cloud, Analyze these vital signs data in the cloud, In order to achieve real-time monitoring of human vital signs data. It has been experimentally verified, The system can stabilize the temperature inside the quilt to 37 degrees Celsius, And can stably upload temperature, heart rate, blood oxygen and other vital signs data to the cloud, When the vital sign data is similar to the preset vital sign danger data (for example, the heart rate data is less than 40 beats/min and greater than 120 beats/min), the system will automatically alarm and upload the vital signs to the help unit in real time. The experimental results show that the system can provide a feasible solution for smart home and smart medical care.

articleTitle: Optimal allocation of mixed microgrid capacity for wind-hydrogen-storage in a certain area of Northeast China
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Northeast China is complex and diverse, with perennial low temp. For the purpose of allocating the capacity of microgrid reasonably in Northeast China and enhance the power supply reliability of microgrid system in Northeast China, this paper takes a place in Northeast China as the study object. According to the characteristics of Northeast China, an optimal allocation model of wind hydrogen storage microgrid capacity with using surplus wind power to produce hydrogen and equipped with battery energy storage device is advised. Considering the real-time impact of northeast low temp on fan output, power load and battery capacity, the capacity of lower microgrid power supply system in Northeast China is optimized with the goal of minimizing annual average cost and the constraint of annual load power shortage rate. The simulation results show that the wind hydrogen storage system can not only improve the system economy and power supply reliability, but also effectively reduce energy waste.

articleTitle: Reliability Modelling of Dynamic Random System Based on Petri Net
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This article uses Petri Nets' ability to describe dynamic systems and applies Petri Nets to the field of mechanical system reliability analysis. The method of expressing fault events and their logical relations based on Petri net theory is studied, and the method of applying Petri net to the reliability modelling of complex dynamic system is discussed. Through the simulation of the model, the reliability of the real-time expert system is analysed, and the relationship curve between the system reliability and the real-time limit and heuristic error is given.

articleTitle: Research on Smart Grid Behaviour Privacy Protection System Based on Spark
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the construction and rapid development of smart grids, short-term load forecasting with high-precision is becoming more and more important. Aiming at the characteristics of massive and heterogeneous grid data, a big data distributed system based on Spark is built to process power grid big data, which realizes the whole process from collection and transmission of grid data, processing, calculation to storage, and the construction of power load forecasting model. However, the ensuing risk of privacy leakage of user behaviour about the electricity usage information has attracted increasing attention. By analysing the electricity consumption information through Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring (NILM) techniques, the attacker can infer the operating status of the user's equipment, and then figure out the user behaviour, which seriously threatens the privacy of individuals and their family. For this reason, we adopted an effective local differential privacy protection method in the power load forecasting process aiming at solving the risk of privacy disclosure. Experiments have shown that this method can guarantee the availability of power data and meanwhile protect the privacy of user behaviour. In the field of smart grid, the system has strong application prospects.

articleTitle: Bidirectional AC-DC Conversion Circuit Based on ADALM2000
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Especially in recent years, with the wide application of IGBT, switching power supply is developing towards higher power. The development of various high-power and high-performance switching power supplies has become a trend. The power supply system designed in this paper requires that the input voltage is AC 28V, the output voltage is DC 36V, the output current is 2A, and the power factor is > 0.99. The DC voltage after one rectification passes through the active power factor correction link to improve the power factor of the system. The voltage is reduced by the Two-phase self-coupling transfer and the two-phase isolation transformer, and then rectified by the full bridge conversion circuit, and finally the DC voltage is output. The main purpose of this design is to complete a 36V/2A high-power AC/DC converter which can be directly connected in parallel. Active power factor correction technology is mainly used to realize the high power factor of the system. In order to meet the needs of direct parallel operation of power supply. ADALM2000 is used to build the design model and collect the test data, so as to lay a solid foundation for the later physical construction.

articleTitle: Analysis of Optimization Method of Laboratory Management System Based on Data Processing and Intelligent Sensor Technology of the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: At present, colleges and universities have done much research on the management of laboratories and equipment on campus. The focus of the work is on the optimization of manual laboratory management. The work content management of the laboratory is still concentrated in the manual management stage. The workload is very large, and the content is very complicated. Therefore, it is necessary to optimize the above problems. In the process of optimization, artificial intelligence and the Internet of Things, as new information age technologies, have received extensive attention. This paper firstly introduces the data processing and intelligent sensor technology of the Internet of Things from the perspective of the traditional laboratory management system. On this basis, it gradually combines artificial intelligence and cloud computing to improve laboratory management's core content. Based on the above technical core, this paper designs and optimizes the laboratory management system of artificial intelligence algorithms.

articleTitle: Importance Sampling-Based Missing Tag Identification Protocol for Large-Scale RFID System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: As a low-cost technology with good application prospects, RFID plays a key role in physical entity perception to enable Internet of Things networks. In large-scale RFID systems, one of the most vital problems is to identify missing tags duly. However, the existing missing tag identification protocols use the same probability for all tags, resulting in the incapability of discovering the loss of valuable goods in time. In this work, an importance sampling-based missing tag identification (ISMTI) protocol is proposed to improve the identification efficiency of important tags. With importance assignment, bloom filter-based unknown tag deactivation and multi-hashed based missing tag identification strategies, ISMTI reduces the number of slots to identify missing tags especially for important tags. Simulation results demonstrates its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Construction of Data Center Security System Based on Micro Isolation under Zero Trust Architecture
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the development of Internet technology, the rapid growth of data volume strongly promotes the construction of data centers, which also makes the security threats to data centers more and more serious. The architecture of the internal network of the data center has changed from the traditional IT architecture to virtualization, hybrid cloud and containerization, and the security isolation inside the data center has become more and more difficult. Aiming at the isolation of the internal network of the data center, the paper builds a more reliable system with the help of the zero-trust thought. On the basis of analyzing the key technologies of micro-isolation and constructing a micro-isolation system, we design a zero-trust security architecture based on micro-isolation propose a zero-trust security system for data center based on micro-isolation, and provides a set of security isolation scheme for the internal network of the data center.

articleTitle: The Design of Asymmetric Wireless Power Transmission Coils with Limited-size
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Due to the limitation of the size of the receiving end of the wearable devices, the coupling coil of the wireless power transmission is usually asymmetric, which makes the design of the resonant wireless power transmission system more complicated, and especially has a certain impact on the transmission distance and efficiency. Aiming at the above problems, the transmission model of the asymmetric wireless power transmission system is established, and the expression of the transmission efficiency of the asymmetric system is calculated. The structure parameters of the transmitting and receiving coil are designed under the transmission distance and the validity is verified by experiments. The results show that there is a coupling structure within the effective transmission range of the system, i.e., the fixed radius, number of turns, and turn spacing of the transmitting coil and the receiving coil, which enables the system to receive the power to reach the critical coupling power, and ensures the high-efficiency and stable power transmission of the system.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of SWIPT Aided Satellite-terrestrial Cooperative Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper proposes a simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT) aided hybrid satellite-terrestrial cooperative network. In particular, an energy-constrained terrestrial user equipment harvests energy from the radio frequency (RF) signal of the terrestrial relay and utilizes the harvested energy to cooperate with a masked terrestrial user equipment. The satellite-relay and satellite-user equipments links are assumed to undergo the Shadowed-Rician (SR) fading, and the channels of terrestrial links are assumed to undergo Rayleigh fading. By assuming that amplify-and-forward (AF) protocol is employed at the terrestrial relay and the energy-constrained terrestrial user equipment, we first derive the probability density function (PDF) expression and cumulative distribution function (CDF) expression for the signal to noise ratios (SNRs) at the energy-constrained terrestrial user equipment and the masked terrestrial user equipment. Then, we derive the outage probablity (OP) expressions of the two user equipments in the proposed network. Finally, theoretical analyses and Monte Carlo simulation results are presented. Our results reveal the impact of system parameters on the performance gains.

Author Keywords: simultaneous wireless information and power transfer (SWIPT)

articleTitle: Design of Crop Growth Environment Monitoring System and Research on Crop Growth Environment Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: For the problems existing in the monitoring and management of crop growth in the development of modern agriculture. To ensure a suitable growth environment for crops in the farmland areas, promote the high-quality growth of crops, and the sustainable development of agriculture, based on data acquisition technology, a monitoring system for crop growth environment in farmland area is proposed in this pape. The system includes an on-site acquisition unit, data processing unit, and remote monitoring unit. Stm32 chip is selected to collect the information of crop growth environments such as temperature, humidity, water level, and soil moisture content. The on-site LCD screen displays relevant information in real-time. The host computer and the controller communicate through the serial port to realize data analysis and processing, and the intelligent terminal is used to monitor farmland areas remotely. At the same time, the weight and threshold of the BP neural network are optimized based on a genetic algorithm, the crop growth environment model is constructed, and the suitability of the growth environment is evaluated. After optimization, the simulation error of the test sample is reduced from 0.1161 to 0.0015, which improves the prediction accuracy and can meet the actual evaluation of the suitable environment for crop growth.

articleTitle: An Implementation of Centralized Controllers for Software-Defined Satellite Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the increasing user demands for higher quality multimedia services, the satellite networks play a vital role in communication networks due to global seamless coverage. However, the time-variant topologies of satellite networks bring great challenges to network management and routing algorithms. This paper aims at applying the software defined networking (SDN) to satellite networks to improve routing calculation efficiency and simplify satellite payloads. Firstly, we obtain the satellite network topologies from a satellite simulation tool and build the satellite network system based on the Iridium constellation. Moreover, the dynamic satellite network topology is divided into multiple static network topologies by dividing time slices. Finally, to get the optimal path, we develop the routing algorithm using the improved Dijkstra algorithm to dynamically establish an end-to-end communication path under the TCP connections, so that the communication between satellites can be achieved.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Network Information Security Attack and Defense Practical Training Platform based on ThinkPHP Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: To solve the current problem of scarce information security talents, this paper proposes to design a network information security attack and defense practical training platform based on ThinkPHP framework. It provides help for areas with limited resources and also offers a communication platform for the majority of information security enthusiasts and students. The platform is deployed using ThinkPHP, and in order to meet the personalized needs of the majority of users, support vector machine algorithms are added to the platform to provide a more convenient service for users.

articleTitle: An automatic warehouse clearance scheme for bulk cargo unloading in ports
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Bulk cargo unloading is often accompanied by the accumulation and surplus of cargo, which in turn causes a series of difficulties in the clearing progress. The current manual clearing method violates the development trend of automation in the port industry and is not conducive to improving the overall economic benefits of the port [1]. We propose an automated clearance scheme and sorts out the internal connections of the scheme in this paper. The application of this scheme can make clearance work get rid of manual operations, shorten clearance time, and improve the efficiency of bulk cargo unloading. The paper first puts forward the overall design of the scheme and then constructs and introduces the three parts of the scheme, including the perception and monitoring system, data processing platform, and clearing robot.

articleTitle: Braille-to-Chinese Translation System Based on Optical Braille Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Braille is an essential tool for visually impaired people to receiving and transmitting information. However, sighted people without special training cannot read Braille, which will cause inconvenience to scenarios such as special education that require sighted people to read Braille. This paper implements a Braille-to-Chinese translation system composed of optical Braille recognition, Braille-to-pinyin conversion, and pinyin-to-character module. Experiments prove that our system can effectively and accurately translate Braille images into Chinese. Our system has broad application prospects, which can help the sighted people read Braille and help visually impaired people in their study and life.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent classified trash can based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low efficiency of waste classification at the present stage, an intelligent classified waste bin based on STM32 single chip microcomputer is designed, which has the functions of automatic identification and classification of waste types. According to the functional requirements, six parts are designed: stepper motor garbage delivery module, garbage full load alarm module, openmv camera identification of multiple types of garbage module, environmental protection video publicity module, multiple communication modules and UCOS real-time operating system. Through the cooperation of each module, it can independently identify the types of garbage for delivery and realize garbage classification. Aiming at the problem of full load of garbage and the rotation angle of different garbage, the hardware part is designed. At the same time, the software design is completed by studying the working principle of openmv. After the prototype is assembled, the test data can be obtained for many times. The garbage identification success rate is high, which can better realize the function of independent garbage classification, so as to enhance the garbage classification ability at the present stage.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Reconstruction and Geo-Positioning Accuracy Analysis Based on UAV Remote Sensing Images
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In recent years, with the wide application of UAV, the scope of photogrammetric 3D modeling based on UAV images has been expanded, and the 3D model contains real geographic scenes, which has been applied to a large number of fields such as smart cities and disaster monitoring. This paper takes the campus of ZAFU as the research area, and carries out 3D modeling of the acquired images with the Phantom 4 RTK by DJI company, and also compares the accuracy of 3D reconstruction by vertical photogrammetry and oblique photogrammetry, which are close to each other in terms of plane accuracy but differ in terms of elevation accuracy. In addition, three UAV flight designs were also compared, among which the absolute positioning accuracy of the ground 3D model obtained by the flight design with known base station coordinates and the network-based RTK flight design was higher.

articleTitle: Communication mechanism for multi-dimension electric power transmission line monitoring network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Electric power transmission line is important electric power infrastructure, whose operation state is linked to the safety of the power grid. Every year a large number of transmission line accidents happened due to internal and external factors. As the development of the sensing technique, such as satellite remote sensing, wireless sensing, optical fiber sensing, it is possible to construct an electric power transmission line monitoring system with heterogenous sensing equipments. In this paper, we formulate the architecture of multi-dimension electric power transmission line monitoring. Data-centric protocol is proposed to implement the heterogenous data exchange. Through the establishment of multi-dimension electric power transmission line monitoring system, the power transmission line corridor wide area monitoring and power transmission line state monitoring can be achieved.

articleTitle: A Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning Model of Internet-Related Markets Evolution
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Internet economic markets have upgraded the traditional ways of product, service, consumption, and processing transactions and prompted the reforming of traditional multisided markets. With this background, our paper presents a multi-agent deep reinforce learning method with group hybrid abstraction called GHA-DQN to build Internet marketplace model and observe the evolution process including initiation and competition periods from the areas of e-transport, e-commerce, e-catering, and other e-markets. The experiment results provide references to support networking, financing, and competition equilibrium in this competitive e-economic world.

articleTitle: Research on E-Commerce User Interest Recommendation Method Based on TF-IDF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In the development process of the e-commerce industry, with the continuous increase of the number of consumer user groups, the base of online shopping user groups is getting larger and larger. In this process, the research on recommendation algorithms for different user groups is very important. The current research has made some progress, but there are still some problems, such as the data classification for user portraits is not specific enough, the feature extraction algorithm has related deficiencies, and the data recommendation accuracy is not enough. On this basis, this paper adjusts the word frequency and inverse document frequency of the recommended keywords. It introduces the TF-IDF algorithm to recommend targeted product keywords for different user portraits, effectively solving inaccurate recommendation results.

articleTitle: Machining of Automotive Ultra-Precision Parts and Detection and Control of Residual Stress on the Surface
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of high-end automotive product quality and diversified demands, more and higher requirements are put forward for ultra-precision machining. This paper proposes a clamping method for ultra-precision machining of cylindrical parts. Use ANSYS software to simulate and analyze the deformation of the three clamping methods. According to the comparison results, the optimal card installation method was selected to carry out experimental research work to verify the reliability of the scheme and the rationality of the card installation method. The process route and control method of residual stress detection after machining of parts are proposed with 4J32 material experimental samples. By adopting reasonable technological methods, the research precision of ultra-precision parts in automobiles is improved. The experimental results prove that the proposed machining plan of ultra-precision parts and the detection and control method of surface residual stress have important application value and practical significance for improving product quality, accelerating product renewal, and improving economic efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Platform for Intelligent Warfare
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Intelligent warfare has the characteristics of adaptive construction and dynamic reorganization, which is different from traditional warfare. The different warfare modes lead to the change of simulation modeling, and then lead to the change of simulation platform supporting modeling and simulation warfare. Based on the analysis of four kinds of simulation platform based on reflection memory network, distributed environment, parallel computing environment and middleware, combining with the characteristics of intelligent warfare application, a kind of implementation framework of simulation platform for intelligent warfare is proposed, and the organization mode of intelligent algorithms under this framework is given. This study has important theoretical significance and reference value.

articleTitle: Design of Robot Intelligent Grasping System Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In researching intelligent robots, the grasping ability of robots is a very important skill, which has received extensive attention from researchers, and this technology has been widely used in industrial production. But in the current industrial environment, the grasping design of this type of robot is not perfect. This is because the industrial environment is complex and dynamic, so there are certain difficulties in identifying and extracting the environment, making it difficult for the traditional robot grasping system to judge the environment. Therefore, this paper Mainly redesigns the robot grasping system, including designing the robot's attitude system and grasping path. On this basis, the relevant algorithms of the local feature recognition of the environment and the robot grasping system are used, which greatly improves the accuracy and efficiency of robot grasping.

articleTitle: Optimal dispatch of power system with energy storage considering thermal power peaking initiative and demand response
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: First, the price-based demand response is used on the load side to guide users to actively participate in load adjustment and reduce the summit-to-valley difference of the framework; then, the summit stricture initiative constraint of the broiling power squad is added to make room for wind power; next, the energy storage equipment on the power station side is configured and integfrequencyd into the summit scrubbing auxiliary business of the framework together with the summit scrubbing broiling power squad. Finally, based on the purposefulness compiler of ideal framework political and minimum wind curtailment frequency, the ideal dispatch model of energy storage power framework is constructed, and numerical study case analysis is given.

articleTitle: Disclosing Features and Characteristics of. COM Registrars' WHOIS Servers
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The number of top-level domain names(.COM) registrars has long been dominant in the world's domain name resources. Still, few relevant documents have made specific analyses and statistics on the characteristics of. COM registrars. In this context, for the first time, we conducted a large-scale detection study on the WHOIS server of the. COM registrar. This article analyzes the characteristics of the. COM registrar from five aspects: the relationship between the world's top. COM registrar and the server and IP; the relationship between the IP address of the WHOIS server and the WHOIS server; nonexistent domain names response to different messages; abnormalities of WHOIS server; distribution of GDPR. In this article, through large-scale detection and analysis of the WHOIS server of the. COM registrar, we can intuitively see the relevant data of the WHOIS server. The COM registrar discovers the vital relationship between the registrar, server, and IP. The research on the direction of the WHOIS server of the. COM registrar provided by scientific researchers has played a perfect guiding role.

articleTitle: Mitigation Methods of Short-time Diurnal Magnetic Noise in Airborne Magnetic Survey
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The short-time diurnal variation magnetic noise is an important factor restricting the further improvement of the quality of airborne magnetic survey data. Since it is random and nonstationary, simple filtering methods cannot suppress it. Considering its characteristics of wide spatial distribution and strong spatial consistency, this paper proposes two adaptive filtering methods, Kalman filtering method and an improved normalized Least Mean Square (INLMS) adaptive filtering algorithm, to remove the diurnal variation magnetic noise measured by airborne magnetic sensors. These two methods can not only reduce in real time the influence of short-time diurnal variation magnetic noise by setting a reference magnetic sensor, but also avoid the influence of the outliers in the reference magnetic data. The actual experiments show that the two methods can effectively suppress the diurnal variation magnetic noise in airborne magnetic survey data, thereby improving the signal-noise ratio (SNR) of magnetic survey data and recovering the target magnetic signal well.

articleTitle: The application of RBF network in teaching management system
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In teaching quality evaluation, the most important content is the teacher's teaching evaluation. With the speeding up of education informationization, the current teaching management difficulty is how to use network technology to evaluate teachers' teaching quality in traditional teaching, and how to evaluate teachers' teaching quality in network teaching environment is also a key problem in the development of network teaching. In the simulation tool, the BP neural network evaluation model is used to train and study the teaching quality data in a certain amount.

articleTitle: Investigation of Machine Learning Methods for Oxidation and Tensile Creep Properties of SiC/SiC Composites
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the brilliant properties of the low density, high strength and fracture toughness at high temperatures, SiC fiber-reinforced SiC matrix composites are currently being applied for aircraft engine hot-section components. However, both the oxidation and creep resistance of SiC/SiC composites still needed to be improved under different stress, temperature and atmosphere. In order to alleviate the high cost of experimental data collection and the limited data resources, a novel numerical strategy based on machine learning method will be investigated with combination of both the current law of the physical model and the available experimental data. The data-driven analysis results show that in the case of a small amount of training data, neural network has better fitting effect than traditional data fitting methods for univariate fitting; In addition, it is better benefit for reflecting the influence law of multiple variables on the change of material residual strength and quality.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of CPI Index Intelligent Prediction Based on ARIMA & LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper selects the data of China's consumer price index(CPI) from 1985 to 2020. Through the establishment of traditional prediction model ARIMA and machine learning prediction model LSTM, the trend of China's CPI is judged and predicted, and the prediction results and prediction accuracy are compared. The results show that the two methods have their own advantages and disadvantages in different years. Overall, the prediction accuracy of LSTM is higher than that of ARIMA model.

articleTitle: Analysis of JPEG2000 Compression Quality of Optical Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Remote sensing satellite image compression processing technology is an important means to realize high-quality image and fast data transmission at the same time. This paper analyzed the basic principles of the JPEG2000 compression algorithm, and discussed satellite image quality evaluation methods and indicators. A large number of high-resolution images of Mapping satellite-1 with the best compression rate with different surface features were selected as the test samples, and the JPEG2000 compression algorithm was used, the wavelet transform was used to compress and reconstruct 25 magnifications, and the trend and characteristics of the peak signal-to-noise ratio of the image with the compression magnification were analyzed. Combined with research results, satellite resources can be rationally allocated and the effectiveness of satellite photography can be improved.

articleTitle: Substation Electric Energy Metering Terminal with the Function of Network Topology Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In view of the lack of accuracy and reliability of gateway electricity metering at substation, as well as the increasingly complex networking structure and frequent changes of operation parameters, a high-precision energy metering algorithm based on ADC (Analog to Digital Converter) chip and MCU (Microcontroller Unit) is proposed. At the same time, based on the collected and calculated electric energy data, the identification results of electric physical quantities are added into the physical line identification technology based on SNR and noise prediction technology for comprehensive judgment, which can realize fast and automatic identification of substation network topology.

articleTitle: Dual-Band Impedance Matching Transformer with Optimized Total Structure Lengths
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: To reduce design size and realize the structure miniaturization, this article presents a dual-band (DB) impedance matching transformer with optimized total structure lengths. The proposed transformer is composed of two parts in series. The first part is a L-type structure with one loaded stub and one transmission line, responsible for realizing 0.02 conductance value at lower frequency <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{1}$</tex>. When certain type and length of stub is selected, the L-type structure can own the shortest line length. The other part in series is a H-shaped form, separately completing electric susceptance matching at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{1}$</tex> and the admittance matching at the second frequency i.e. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{2}$</tex>. The H-shaped structure has four parameters, one related to fixed <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pi/2$</tex> electrical length at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{1}$</tex> is used to match required susceptance about <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{2}$</tex>, one adopted to obtain 0.02 conductance at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{2}$</tex>, the others are applied to realizing the match at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{1}$</tex> and obtaining the smallest size of H-shaped structure. In design, the proposed transformer adopts a cascade matching mode as a whole, that is, according to the sequence, the matching at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{1}$</tex> is completed first, and then the load matching at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{2}$</tex> is achieved. To make design simpler and convenient, only two line widths are used with characteristic impedance 50 Ohms and 120 Ohms. Hereinto, 50 Ohms is arranged to the main transmission line connecting the load and matching source, and 120 Ohms to loaded stubs. The load with resistances and capacitance is given to gain different complex numbers at two arbitrary independent frequencies i.e. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{1}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$f_{2}$</tex>. An example based on the proposed transformer is designed to verify the ideas and related calculation equations. Simulated and calculated results are in good agreement.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Parameter Estimation Method of Distribution Equipment Fault Rate Model
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of China's economy and power grid construction, the scale of power system and urban power grid has been expanding. The distribution network has been continuously transformed and expanded, and its scale has also been expanding. Reliability is an important standard for evaluating distribution system. In this paper, the intelligent parameter estimation method of distribution equipment failure rate model is studied, the mixed distribution model of component failure is established, the parameter estimation method in the mixed distribution model is proposed, the historical data of a certain stage is selected, and the proposed model is verified by three comparison schemes, The validity of the model is ensured.

articleTitle: Design of integrated transaction mode of source network load storage interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The construction of a new power system will bring a wide access to a high proportion of new energy. Based on the randomness, volatility, dispersion and other characteristics of new energy power generation, it is required that the load side is connected through a variety of equipment such as energy storage and distributed generation, and the energy consumption mode will change from “source with load” to “source network load interaction”. This paper studies the transaction organization mode of source network load storage interaction, and organizes interactive transactions through monthly listing transactions, daily power decomposition and interactive deviation assessment, so as to realize the transaction price according to the market and win-win situation of source network load storage.

articleTitle: Long-Term and Short-Term Integrated Learning-Based Price Forecasting for Virtual Currency
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: As the blockchain and digital economy are becoming mature, a growing number of investors enter the virtual money market. How to exploit the available data to predict the changing trend of the virtual currency has been a focus. On account of the SVR model, this paper proposes a virtual currency price forecasting model with long-term and short-term integrated learning, taking advantage of extensive virtual currency price data to demonstrate the proposed model. The simulation experiment confirm that the accuracy of the SVR model is indeed increased on the virtual currency price forecasting issue.

articleTitle: Discussion and Analysis on the Design of Electric Power Whole-Process Video Visualization Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In the process of rapid social and economic development, the power system is gradually developing towards intelligence and remoteness. Traditional operation and management methods have obviously not been able to adapt to the development requirements of the current power system. As a key component of the smart power grid, the reasonable configuration of the remote digital monitoring system of the power system, coupled with the application of image recognition technology, plays a pivotal role in the production, operation, maintenance, management, and emergency handling of the power grid. Through the analysis and introduction of remote video surveillance system and digital image recognition technology, it is expected that it can help the power system can provide support in terms of the rapid transformation and management optimization of the power system, as well as the abnormality test of the equipment, thus guaranteeing the safe, stable and efficient operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Research of Transformer Fault Diagnosis Algorithm Based on Stacked Sparse Autocoding
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Oil immersed transformer is one of the most significant pieces of equipment in the power transmission and transformation system, and its safety is critical to maintaining the system's stability. A transformer PD platform built in this paper and the signals of high-frequency pulse current, UHF, as well as ultrasonic under PD of three typical defects is obtained. Three groups of characteristic parameters for the three signals to judge the fault type of the transformer are extracted. A stack sparse auto-encoding technique is built to fuse the three sets of feature and diagnose faults. The results show that the constructed algorithm's recognition accuracy is significantly higher than that of the traditional kernel principal component analysis method, and the recognition accuracy of multi-source information fusion is higher than that of single information, with recognition accuracy of 96.5% after the fusion of the three signals.

articleTitle: Design Scheme of High Frequency Small Signal Amplifier
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, radio technology is widely used in various fields of national economy, military and people's daily life, and the technical level is higher and higher. In the radio communication system, electrical signals are radiated to space in the form of electromagnetic waves through wireless. Therefore, in radio technology, we often face such problems. The received signal is very weak, and it is easy to be disturbed by other signals and noise. Moreover, in long-distance communication and transportation, the signal will also decay and, and the signal reaching the receiving equipment becomes very weak, so it is difficult to ensure the accuracy of information. Therefore, in the transmission process, the received signal shall be selected and amplified to ensure the accuracy of the information transmitted to the receiving equipment and reduce errors. In this way, it is necessary to use high-frequency small signal tuning amplifier. It can sense many weak high-frequency small signals (the input signal voltage is generally near the order of uV to mV), and then use the LC resonant circuit as the frequency selection network and the amplification of the triode to select the useful frequency signal for amplification, and suppress the useless frequency signal. Therefore, the high frequency small signal resonant amplifier at the receiver is an important circuit of radio communication equipment. This paper briefly analyzes the design principle of high frequency small signal, LC oscillator and high frequency power amplifier circuit. At the same time, this paper also studies the parameter setting method of each circuit. The designed resonant amplifier is mainly composed of amplifier and tuning loop. In addition, in the design process, this paper first carries out the circuit simulation on Multisim10 circuit simulation software, then draws the schematic diagram combined with the actual situation, buys components and draws the PCB circuit diagram, and finally carries out the physical production and debugging. In the actual circuit, this paper adopts the 10MHz mid cycle instead of the difficult to adjust LC frequency selection circuit, utilizes the s9014 triode to amplify the amplification link, and selects a potentiometer for the emitter resistance to adjust the emitter resistance to change the amplification gain of the amplifier. Simulation and physical debugging results: the resonant frequency is 10MHz, and the circuit also has a certain gain, indicating that the design has been successful.

articleTitle: Interference Alignment Close-form Solutions for Multiple-input Multiple-output Multiple-antenna Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Interference alignment can effectively increase channel capacity, but it is complicated to get the interference alignment solution of multiple-antenna system. Two set of close-form interference alignment solutions are studied in this paper for multiple-input multiple-output asymmetric systems. The users can use different number of receiving and transmitting antennas to get different degrees of freedom in those systems, which adapt to most of requirements in actual scene. The presented close-form solutions can solve interference alignment problems efficiently with the least number of total antennas.

articleTitle: SEM-DCNet: A Self-Supervised Network for SEM Images Zonary Non-Linear Distortion Correction
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Large-scale scanning electron microscope (SEM) has been used to reconstruct the gigantic and complex neural network in the brain, where the natural intelligence is embedded. Due to the limited field of view and the stability of the scanning coils, the ultra-large tiles imaged by single-beam SEM will inevitably exist some zonary non-linear distortions, which could have an unexpected impact on the down-stream stitching, alignment and segmentation. In this paper, we first analyze the parametric expression of the zonary distortion on SEM and then propose a novel self-supervised convolutional neural network named SEM-DCNet to automatically detect and correct the randomly distributed zonary distortion on the SEM images. Experiment on the real-world dataset shows that the proposed method can efficiently correct the distortion to a considerable degree, hence greatly improve the stitching performance under rigid transformation model.

articleTitle: Visual transmission and analysis of graphic language based on image processing technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The application of computer technology has also brought many conveniences to people. As an important part of computer technology, the application of image processing technology in visual transmission system has created rich visual effects for people, and also brought about technical changes for visual transmission design. In this paper, a visual transmission and analysis method of graphic language based on image processing technology is proposed. Enhance the low-light image in HSV color space, optimize the visual transmission design of graphic language by combining tone mapping and color fusion technology, and realize the color separation design of graphic language under the visual transmission model. The simulation results show that the color balance of color separation design of graphic language with this method is better, the visual expression ability of the designed graphic language is stronger, and the image quality level of the pattern is higher.

articleTitle: Application of Student Real Name Data Information Processing Based on Artificial Intelligence Technology in Network Security
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the continuous development of network technology as well as science and technology, artificial intelligence technology and its related scientific and technological applications, in this process, were born. Among them, artificial intelligence technology has been widely used in information detection as well as data processing, and has remained one of the current hot research topics. Those research on artificial intelligence, recently, has focused on the application of network security processing of data as well as fault diagnosis and anomaly detection. This paper analyzes, aiming at the network security detection of students' real name data, the relevant artificial intelligence technology and builds the model. In this process, this paper firstly introduces and analyzes some shortcomings of clustering algorithm as well as mean algorithm, and then proposes a cloning algorithm to obtain the global optimal solution. This paper, on this basis, constructs a network security model of student real name data information processing based on trust principle and trust model.

articleTitle: Design of bi-power reaching law sliding mode controller based on exponential observer
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Considering the complex nonlinear characteristics of the quadrotor system, such as underactuation, strong coupling and susceptibility to disturbance, the disturbance in real time can be estimated by the exponential convergent disturbance observer. Using the disturbance is input compensation. The exponentially convergent disturbance observer is used to resist unknown disturbances. In this paper, a double power reaching law sliding mode controller based on the exponential observer (EO-DSMC) is proposed by combining the exponential observer and the double power reaching rate sliding mode control method, it is applied to the attitude subsystem of the quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV). Lyapunov theory is used to prove the stability of the system. Comparisons of the simulation of the single-machine flight between before and after adding the controller revealed that the designed controller is used to control UAV attitude better and enhanced system stability and anti-interference.

articleTitle: Classification of Landscape Pictures Based on Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The continuous development of artificial intelligence has brought great convenience to our life and work. One of the more mature applications in artificial intelligence is the function of image classification, which provides a new method for us to process massive data. When faced with an explosion of image information on the Internet, we can use deep learning to categorize images and select only the categories we want to stay in. This will save us a lot of time and reduce our workload. This paper is based on deep learning to classify several common types of landscape maps, so that we can easily choose the scenery we want to visit. The residual network structure is adopted in this paper, and the accuracy can reach 87.6% only after low rounds of training, which is better than the previous shallow network structure.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Container Terminal Operation and Maintenance System Based on Global Awareness
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the deepening reform of China's extensive port, it is urgent to build an efficient operation and maintenance system to ensure the stable and long-term operation of port logistics business. And according to the present most ports cannot achieve the real time monitoring of equipment state, spot investigation, this article through to the port is put forward based on the operational system design scheme of global awareness, can realize the port main equipment data acquisition, monitoring, forecasting, etc., improve the operational level of the enterprise and industry, at last, the feasibility of the scheme is verified by practical applications.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Air Quality Prediction Model Based on Urban Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The urban scale gradually expands with the development of the economy, and many problems arise in urbanization. Specifically, the urban traffic environment is gradually worsening. The traffic pressure is increasing with the urban population growth, the tail gas emissions from private cars and the factory exhaust gas produced with the industrial development around the city have caused terrible environmental influence. Therefore, with the rapid economic growth, urban air quality and residents' health have gradually become a hot research topic. In the previous research on air quality, many studies were conducted from a single time dimension, ignoring the continuation of air pollutants on the time scale and the diffusivity on the spatial scale. Therefore, on this basis, this paper proposes a prediction air quality model based on temporal and spatial distribution. By analyzing historical data, we can predict the air quality value from the time and space scales, and then the required results are obtained according to the meteorological conditions to improve forecast accuracy.

articleTitle: Reliability analysis and research of distribution network based on sequential Monte Carlo method
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Distribution network is an important part of power system. Its safety and reliability will directly affect the national economic development and people's living standards. At the same time, with the development of power system, the structure of distribution network is becoming more and more complex, and the reliability has attracted more and more attention. In this paper, a simulation algorithm is established by using sequential Monte Carlo method. Through an example, the sequential Monte Carlo method and analytical method are verified and compared. The results show that the sequential Monte Carlo method can effectively avoid the problems of many components and complex system structure of large-scale power system, and is suitable for the evaluation and calculation of large-scale distribution system.

articleTitle: Safety Exploration and Analysis of the Computer Data Based on the Block Chain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The progress of the time promotes the gradual development of Internet applications, which is particularly important for the safety protection of computer data. On such basis, it is required to make effective settings for computer data protection strategies, established on computer video data modeling, and adopt a multi-level encryption processing method, so as to achieve the establishment and improvement of a sound data transmission model corresponding to a wide postponement. As a result, the reasonable protection of information transmission data can be satisfied, and then the remote data verification protocol can be directly created through the decentralized characteristics of the blockchain. Furthermore, it has a strong reliability to solve information security problems. Therefore, based on the analysis of the advantages of blockchain technology in computer data security protection, and the data verification method, the computer data security based on blockchain technology is eveutually explored in the current research.

articleTitle: Research on satellite Modeling and Real-time Simulation Monitoring Based on MBSE
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The problems existing in the text-based systems engineering method include heavy workload for change management, poor readability of design documents, low reuse rate, inability to simulate and so on. This paper firstly draws on the Magic Grid methodology, which is suitable for complex product development, and comprehensively describes complex systems from multiple views, forming a set of model-based systems engineering modeling methods(MBSE)with strong traceability and logicality;Secondly, the method is applied to the power subsystem, and the models under different views are created using the system modeling language SysML (systems modeling language); Finally, based on the model, real-time simulation monitoring is carried out for the behavior activity graph, and the model simulation process can be traced back. It is verified that the modeling method can better design the system and meet the requirements of complex system design.e system and meet the requirements of complex system design.

articleTitle: Towards Recoverability-Oriented Cloud Operations
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The dependability of consumer-initiated cloud operations has become a hot research topic in the field of cloud computing. Such a cloud operation's dependability can be achieved by enabling its recoverability, e.g. applying recovery actions for errors during cloud operations. In order to facilitate cloud operations' recoverability, one way is to design more recoverability-oriented cloud operations. Cloud operations designed with more effective recoverability-oriented characteristics can receive recovery actions by a recovery service with ease. In this paper, we propose a methodology of how to make such kind of cloud operations. Specifically, the methodology contains three steps: 1) operation prototype design; 2) cloud resources analysis; 3) operation prototype transformation. We demonstrate our methodology by using the widely used rolling upgrade operation on AWS Cloud.

articleTitle: Design and error analysis of a fast phase difference detection algorithm for sinusoidal characteristic signal
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The paper mainly explains a fast detection algorithm of sine wave phase difference applied to embedded equipment and applies the algorithm to practical engineering. It samples and compares the data in the actual environment, gives the deviation between the calculation result of the algorithm and the theoretical value under different conditions, different parameters, and different sampling rates, and analyzes and compares the calculation results. The data of the experimental results provide a basis for the subsequent algorithm research. The design of the algorithm provides a new solution for the calculation of the phase difference algorithm in the field of communication.

articleTitle: Energy Saving Programming of Distribution Network Considering High Permeability Renewable Energy Access
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In view of the increasing proportion of renewable energy access in distribution network, the traditional programming method was unable to meet the needs of power grid development. A hierarchical and zoned energy-saving programming method for distribution network with high proportion of renewable energy was proposed. Firstly, the capacity and layout of high proportion renewable energy were optimized to realize the initial site selection and capacity determination of renewable energy. Secondly, taking the renewable energy planning results as the initial value, a bi-level iterative programming model was constructed to realize the optimization decision making model with cost and energy-saving benefits as the goal. Finally, the harmony search algorithm was used to solve the proposed optimization model. The real power grid data is used for analysis. The simulation results show the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed model and method.

articleTitle: Research on Weight Optimization of Fluidlastic Isolator of Helicopter Main Reduction Based on Isight Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: As a vibration isolation device that can effectively isolate the exciting force transmitted from the rotor to the fuselage, the fluidlastic isolator is generally installed in the transmission channel of the main reduction, which puts forward strict requirements for the structural size and weight design of the fluidlatic isolator. In this paper, a structural weight optimization analysis method based on Isight platform is proposed, and a single objective optimization model of structural weight is established by integrating the self-made weight analysis program of fluidlastic isolator. The model takes the structural size of the key position of the vibration isolator as the design variables, taking the minimum weight of the whole vibration isolator as the goal, and taking the dynamic stiffness, vibration isolation efficiency, length and frequency of the vibration isolator as the constraints, which is solved by the pointer all-round optimizer to realize the weight optimization design of the vibration isolator.
