After optimization, the overall structure of the vibration isolator is more compact and the weight is reduced by 12.5%. The results show that a fast and effective optimization system is formed by integrating the structural weight analysis program through the Isight optimization platform, which has guiding significance for the structural design of fluidlastic isolator.

articleTitle: An Anomaly Detection Framework for Multi-Variate Time Series in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The electric vehicle is drawing great attention recently because of both the convenience it offers and the safety issues it possesses. With more vehicle driving log files available, we are able to use the data mining techniques to cope with these safety issues, e.g., thermal runaway. In this paper, we propose an anomaly detection framework for electric vehicles using the multi-variate time series data collected from vehicles driving log files. Some experimental results are shown to validate the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Research on Neural Network Hardware Scheme for Frequency Measurement and Direction Finding
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: There are many hardware implementation schemes of neural network, each with its own advantages and disadvantages. This scheme puts forward a feasible scheme for Hopfield network to solve the specific problem of frequency measurement and direction finding. It is characterized by fast speed, learning and network evolution and integration, can directly access I/O, simple and feasible to achieve, with faster speed than software simulation.

articleTitle: Facial Expression Recognition Method Based on SpResNet-ViT
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Expression recognition in wild is susceptible to factors such as object occlusion and large pose. Existing facial expression recognition models lack the use of relationships between non-occluded regions. To address this problem, the SpResNet-Vit(ResNet with SoftPool-Vision Transformer) model consisting of a feature extraction module and a vision Transformer module is proposed. First, the original image is cropped and the feature extraction of the cropped image is performed using the optimized ResNet network; then, the attention to the non-occluded regions is enhanced using the self-attention module; finally, the internal relationships of the non-occluded facial regions are modeled using the global self-attention mechanism of the Vision Transformer. Our SpResNet-ViT is tested on three publicly available datasets, CK+, FERPlus and RAF-DB, and 98.6%, 88.1% and 87.3% accuracy rates were realized, which is significantly superior compared with current mainstream algorithms.

articleTitle: Iterative Geometric Calibration Algorithm Based on Projection Point Correction
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In the healthcare engineering field, the mobile X-ray system is becoming more and more popular in tomographic reconstruction and surgical navigation. The calibration of the geometric relationship between the X-ray source and detector is very important for tomographic reconstruction and surgical navigation. In this paper, an iterative geometric calibration algorithm based on projection point correction is proposed, and a double-layer calibration object is designed for calibration. Firstly, the geometric parameters are roughly estimated by using the geometric center point of the projection contour of the steel ball as the projection point. Then, through iteration, the projection points are corrected by using the relationship between the projection contour and internal parameters of the steel ball. The accuracy of our algorithm is proved by simulation and practical experiments.

articleTitle: An Improved Indoor Positioning Method Based on Received Signal Strengths
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of distribution network planning and system optimization after adding renewable energy, a hierarchical and zoning planning model considering investment cost and energy saving effect is proposed. After the objective function of the total investment cost is specified in the upper level planning, the access planning of renewable energy and the corresponding constraints are considered. The lower level takes the addition of energy storage and the minimum line loss as the objective function. The minimum network loss is calculated through the power planning given by the upper level to generate the optimal combination scheme.

articleTitle: Distributed Streaming Computing Mode Based on Fast Message Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The computing mode of distributed streaming computing system depends on the message transmission delay between nodes. Low data processing delay and high system throughput are one of the core indexes of distributed streaming computing system. By analyzing the characteristics of streaming data, the message sending and receiving mode and message processing mode of processing nodes under the application of real-time streaming computing. This paper presents a computing mode suitable for streaming computing applications. The computing mode optimizes the way of sending and receiving data by processing nodes and improves the way of data processing. The test results show that the designed computing mode has the advantages of high data throughput and low message processing delay.

articleTitle: Research on optimization of agricultural products foreign trade logistics network based on heuristic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the increasing consumer demand and the continuous expansion of urban scale, the cold chain logistics in China is developing rapidly. Agricultural products are perishable and regional, which is an important application field of cold chain logistics. Due to the current cold chain logistics network is not perfect, cold chain facilities and equipment is not perfect, resulting in serious damage to agricultural products, circulation costs remain high. Logistics distribution of agricultural products can be regarded as a variant of TSP. Traveling salesman problem (TSP) is a classical NP complete problem, which has a wide range of applications and practical application value. Product logistics plays an important role in the development of agricultural production and the prosperity of rural economy. Establishing a sound agricultural product foreign trade logistics system will help reduce waste in agricultural foreign trade logistics. Reduce the cost of agricultural products' foreign trade logistics and enhance the international competitiveness of agricultural products. Realize the automatic optimization of agricultural product logistics network flow, thereby optimizing the entire logistics network to a certain extent and reducing the logistics cost of agricultural products.

articleTitle: Simulation of Indoor Pseudolite Positioning Accuracy Based on EKF
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper proposes an ergodic robust Kalman filter(ERKF) algorithm to improve the positioning accuracy of pseudo-satellite. This algorithm will look for and compare all the threshold independently in the given range, choose the one that is most suitable for the measurement environment as the threshold of the algorithm, then bring it into the ERKF model, ERKF finally gets the filtered data. Emulations by Matlab were performed, and the results show that after ERKF, the average standard deviations of X-axis, Y-axis and X-Y plane have reduced by 0.9126m, 1.323m and 7.9161m. This paper also compares the filtering performance of ERKF with that of ordinary Kalman filter(KF), and the results show that ERKF has higher accuracy and stability. The ERKF presented in this paper can effectively improve the accuracy of indoor pseudo-satellite system.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of the Fusion Method of the Real Image and Three Dimensional Geographical Features for VR
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that real image cannot realize the single representation of geographic entities when expressing geospatial information, a vr-oriented real image and three dimensional geographic features fusion method was proposed. Firstly, point cloud and panoramic image data around roads were collected by vehicle mobile measurement system to generate quantifiable sequencing street view and realize the spatial realization of real scene data. Then, reconstruct and encode three dimensional geographical features to make them more concise. Finally, the spatial measurable real scene image data is fused with simplified three dimensional geographical features to achieve intuitive, three dimensional and fact-based expression of three dimensional geographical space. The research results show that the proposed method can realize the effective fusion of real image and three dimensional geographical features, and provide a reference for real scene three dimensional construction.

articleTitle: Research on the Intelligent Air-defense Command and Decision System Based on Multi-agent
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Air-defense command and decision system is a distributed, heterogeneous, loosely coupled, and complex artificial intelligent control system. Collaborative decision-making based on multi-agent system is an effective way to achieve joint operational command and control system. By studying the traditional combat simulation model, a coordinated operation decision model was proposed based on multi-agent, and the intelligent air-defense decision support system framework was given. Finally, the adaptability and decision-making efficiency of the decision-making model in real-time combat environment were analyzed.

articleTitle: Study on Dynamic Characteristics of Distributed Power Wing Structure with Electronically Controlled Propeller
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Considering the rigid-flexible coupling characteristics of distributed propeller/nacelle/wing, the structural dynamic equation of the coupling system is established by using the medium deformation beam theory and Hamilton principle. The variation trend of the vibration mode of the wing structure in the coupling system is calculated when the propeller speed, number and chord direction of the hub center deviate from the elastic axis of the wing. The results show that the propeller speed and the central chord offset of the hub mainly affect the first-order torsional modal frequency of the wing. With the increase of the speed or the offset, the first-order torsional modal frequency of the wing shows a parabolic or linear downward trend; In addition, due to the influence of the chord offset installation of the propeller, the first-order torsional and second-order flapping modes of the wing have a strong bending torsional coupling effect, and the flapping modes and flapping component modes are greatly affected by the speed and chord offset; The increase of the number of propellers makes the first-order torsional modal frequency of the wing decline sharply at high speed, resulting in the instability of the dynamic characteristics of the system.

articleTitle: A Study on the Power Dispatching Automation System Based on the Reactive Voltage Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the continuous development of power enterprises in China, the automatic control technology not only facilitates the overall upgrading of power grids, but also enhances the automation level of power grid dispatching. This technology combines data monitoring, energy management, information management, power grid management, and the grid dispatching control system. Hence it is sufficient to improve the operation and management of power grid dispatching comprehensively. This study analyzes the power dispatching automation system based on the reactive voltage technology, introduces the design for the power dispatching automation system, and describes relevant experiments. Hopefully, its study findings will provide a new direction for managing the reactive voltage of power grid dispatching and facilitating power grids' sustainable development.

articleTitle: Application Implementation of K-means Algorithm Based on Wolf Pack Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: K-means in non-hierarchical clustering analysis has become the most commonly used clustering algorithm because of its simple implementation and fast convergence speed. However, different selection of clustering center will greatly affect the clustering effect of k-means. If the clustering center is selected randomly, the algorithm will easily fall into the local optimal value and fail to achieve the optimal effect. Therefore, the uncertainty of initial clustering centers makes k-means algorithm lack of good stability. Thus, a K-means algorithm based on AEWPA (KAEWPA) is proposed in this paper to enhance the stability of clustering.

articleTitle: Research on Operation Load Distribution Mechanism and Optimization of Global IOT Intelligent Network in Power System Based on Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IOT) uses IOT technology for state awareness and decision control, which improves the intelligence level of power grid and is an important part of promoting the future development of power industry. It is of great significance to study the workload distribution mechanism in edge computing to improve the performance of IOT. This paper considers the edge node resource allocation and terminal task allocation in the workload allocation process of power system global IOT intelligent network, and studies the services with different needs, including the workload allocation of service delay minimization and delay energy consumption balance optimization. Simulation results show that this algorithm can better balance the relationship between the two optimization objectives, and can get smaller delay under different energy consumption constraints compared with other multi-objective algorithms.

Author Keywords: Power system global IOT intelligent network

articleTitle: Analysis of Comprehensive Algorithm Based on the Driving Range of Electric Vehicles in China
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of inconsistency between the driving range tested by the electric vehicle laboratory and the actual driving range of consumers, this study adopts the Chinese working conditions in line with the actual Chinese roads, and considers the high temperature air conditioning refrigeration and low temperature air conditioning heating through the questionnaire survey system. Based on actual user scenarios, a set of objective, efficient and comprehensive electric vehicle driving range evaluation methods have been established. At the same time, drawing on the experience of Europe, combined with the actual working conditions of Chinese roads, a rapid test method (shortening method) for the driving range of electric vehicles has been formed. Longer questions improve test efficiency.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation of High Frame Rate Real-time Image Tracking Technology Based on Compressed Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In recent years, the compressed sensing theory in the field of signal processing has broken the Nyquist sampling theorem that the signal sampling rate must be more than twice the signal bandwidth in the traditional sampling process to accurately reconstruct the original signal, which greatly reduces the cost of information storage, processing and transmission. Target tracking is an important research topic in the field of computer vision. Target tracking has a great impact on human life and has been widely used. For example, security monitoring, human-computer interaction, military field and so on, but there are still many challenges in target tracking, such as illumination intensity change, background disturbance, occlusion, scale change and so on. Target tracking technology is a typical application of computer image vision technology. Aiming at the problem of large amount of computation and poor real-time performance in the process of video image target tracking, this paper uses compressed sensing algorithm to reduce the dimension of target features to reduce the amount of computation, and combines naive Bayesian classifier to recognize the target. Finally, this paper presents a tracking system using compressed sensing algorithm to sparse express target features. Through experiments, it can be found that the system has high tracking accuracy.

Author Keywords: High frame rate real-time image tracking technology

articleTitle: Failure Prediction Mechanism of Disk Devices Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In order to reduce the impact of the disk device failure on the information system performance fluctuation and business services, a disk device failure prediction mechanism based on LSTM is proposed based on the disk state feature extraction and neural network model. Firstly, based on the SMART information, the performance data and the function attenuation characteristics of the disk, the characteristic index of the disk device is selected and extracted. Then, a disk device failure prediction mechanism is established based on the improved LSTM by using the characteristic index as the training set. Finally, the active failure prediction of disk device was developed. Performance analysis shows the failure prediction mechanism of disk device proposed can obtain online prediction function through the data pre-processing methods such as SMART data item selecting, disk loss feature construction, the data item cleaning, and the sample standardization. The proposal is superior to the traditional neural network model in terms of the error square sum and correction decision coefficient.

articleTitle: Control Method of Rare Earth Extraction Process Based on Optimization Setting
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of complex working conditions, large error of empirical control and low efficiency of manual adjustment in rare earth extraction process, a predictive control method based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) was proposed to reduce economic cost. Firstly, wavelet neural network (WNN) for rare earth extraction process was described. Secondly, using particle swarm optimization (PSO) to obtain the economic costs of minimum flow control value and monitoring level components in the optimal value, according to the objective function of extraction production conditions set economic cost. And then using the method of generalized predictive control (GPC) to achieve the optimal value of components in tracking control. Finally, based on the actual operation data of the extraction process of cerium, praseodymium and neodymium (CePr/Nd), the experiment results show that the proposed method can adjust and control the flow value in time when the extraction process is disturbed by the external environment, so that the content distribution of components is stable at the optimal value, which can meet the requirements of stable, accurate, rapid and economic rare earth extraction.

articleTitle: The Research of Detail Detection Based on the Deep Learning and Objector Tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Lung cancer is a threatening growth worldwide, with the highest morbidity and mortality of cancer types, and its incidence is showing an increasing trend. Its horror and mortality rate have increased at the fastest rate, and it is also the greatest threat to people's well-being and lives. Because the initial symptoms of lung cancer are not obvious, many patients miss the best time for treatment. Low-dose lung CT scan images can be effectively used in the early diagnosis of lung cancer. Therefore, how to efficiently extract key lesion features from lung CT images and use the features for target detection has become an effective auxiliary method for early diagnosis of lung cancer, and it is also one of the key technologies of medical images and computer vision. The early lesion features of lung cancer are manifested in the form of lung nodules, so the detection of lung nodules is the first step in lung cancer screening. Therefore, how to quickly find the area of lung cancer damage within the time of early detection is very important. In order to identify lung cancer nodules, this article uses target tracking technology to find possible chemotactic space for malignant growth cells through target tracking, and then uses convolutional neural tissue for additional grouping. We propose a deep learning system for the lung cancer conclusions supported by the PC. Determine whether each knob is dangerous and determine the possibility of malignant growth based on these results.

articleTitle: Simulation study and optimal design of a new microstrip quasi-Yagi antenna for WiFi frequency band applications
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This paper proposes a new microstrip quasi-Vagi antenna for WiFi band applications. The antenna structure employs an E-type reflector as well as 8 split-ring resonators, which makes the quasi-Vagi antenna with high gain and wide bandwidth to meet the requirements of wireless communication. Ansys simulation is used to model and analyze the gain, return loss and radiation direction characteristics of the antenna. Finally, the new microstrip quasi-Yagi is obtained, which has the largest gain of 7.28dB and can work at 2.32-2.66GHz with a relative bandwidth of 14%, covering the WiFi band. The antenna has a simple structure, easy to use, low cost, is powerful, and has good practical application value in projects with a large demand for antenna directional gain.

articleTitle: Lightweight PM-YOLO Network Model for Moving Object Recognition on the Distribution Network Side
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: For the problems of large size and high computation of deep convolutional neural network (CNN) models, which make it difficult to achieve real-time detection on resource-limited mobile or embedded devices, and the existing lightweight models are not sufficient for detection of small targets on the distribution side, a model compression algorithm that combines multi-scale detection and lightweight target recognition PM-YOLO (Prune-MobileNetv3-YOLOv5s) is proposed to achieve efficient detection. Based on the YOLOv5s model, feature information detection is performed at different scales by adding a network processing layer for small targets to improve model recognition accuracy. Target recognition backbone network is reconfigured based on improved MobileNetv3, which reduces model parameters and convolutional operations and improves target recognition rate. Based on iterative sparsity training, the pruning method eliminates redundant parameters, thus compressing model volume and computation volume to the limit. Fine-tuning techniques and related optimization means are used to ensure that the accuracy error of the model before and after compression is within an acceptable range. The experimental results show that under the same test set and test environment, in compared with the YOLOv5s target recognition algorithm, the PM-YOLO algorithm compresses the YOLOv5s model volume by 85.4%, reduces the floating-point type computation by 84.6%, increases the prediction speed by 3.7 times, and achieves 90.6% accuracy of the compressed model recognition with only 1.5% accuracy loss. The proposed method has high detection accuracy and real-time detection speed while reducing the platform volume power consumption storage and computing power requirements, which has obvious advantages over existing lightweight models and is more conducive to the deployment of the model in resource-limited mobile, thus, making the supervision function of moving targets more accessible.

articleTitle: An Intrusion Detection Method Integrating KNN and Transfer Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: As a network security defence technology, an intrusion detection system (IDS) can effectively detect network attack behaviour, significantly protecting network security. Machine learning has been widely used in intrusion detection to improve network intrusion detection and shows the advantages of more intelligence and accuracy than traditional methods. However, intrusion detection based on conventional machine learning requires that the training samples meet the conditions of independent and identical distribution, and data imbalance affects modelling and training. This paper proposes a new intrusion detection model KnTrELM, which integrates KNN and transfer extreme-learning-machine to solve the problems. KnTrELM first applies KNN to detect and delete outlier data to obtain a small-scale and high-quality training data set. Then, based on the transfer learning and extreme learning machine, a transfer extreme learning machine method is proposed. It utilizes the correlation between a large number of labelled data in the source and the target domain data with only a small number of samples, through the probability adaptation between domains, transferring the similar knowledge of source to the target domain, to improve the learning ability of unbalanced samples. Compared with the other four benchmark algorithms, KnTrELM dramatically shortens the training time, increases the training efficiency, and enhances the detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Intelligent Operation Inspection and Monitoring System of Substation Based on Image Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: To explore the intelligent operation and inspection mode of unattended substation, this paper studies the intelligent operation and inspection monitoring system, and studies the structure, function, software and hardware configuration of the intelligent operation and inspection monitoring system based on image recognition technology. The intelligent operation and inspection monitoring system of substation plans to establish two levels of platforms, namely, station-side and remote-side, which are deployed at three levels, namely, station, maintenance patrol center and substation, and can be accessed at any time through the web, so as to realize the analysis and application of all-service data at the station-side. The station system integrates the original video surveillance system, inspection robot system, etc., and adds an image recognition module to realize one-button sequence control and intelligent inspection functions, forming an integrated platform, and displaying the equipment status more comprehensively and intensively. The research can solve the contradiction between the increasing number of substation equipment and the insufficient number of operation and maintenance personnel, solve the practical problems of substation operation and maintenance, ask for manpower from science and technology, rationalize and standardize substation operation and maintenance management, reduce the pressure of operation and maintenance, improve the production efficiency of Substation, share the operation volume of operators, and ensure the safe and stable operation of power grid.

articleTitle: ZMap performance in open DNS resolver discovery
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: ZMap is a famous host discovery tool. Since open DNS resolvers (ODNSes) are a specific concern host, ZMap is also widely used to discover ODNSes. This study investigates whether ZMap is suitable for large-scale ODNS discovery. For this intention, our study designs a controlled experiment to compare ZMap with our self-built system. The experiment results show that the number of ODNSes that ZMap gets is less than our self-built system. To figure out the reason for this, we have summarized three influencing factors and verified the factors by a series of experiments. Additionally, based on the research, we propose some suggestions for making ZMap perform better in ODNS discovery.

articleTitle: Performance of LDPC and Turbo Coded Power Line Communication over Multipath Channel and Narrowband Noise
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Low-voltage Power Line Communication (PLC) is an efficient and easy-deployed approach for data transmission while using the power lines as channels. Since power lines connect with many kinds of electric devices and are always exposed to open working environments, the PLC channels typically suffer from sever narrowband interference or noise, as well as deep multi-path fading. To guarantee a reliable transmission in PLC, efficient error control techniques have been developed. Turbo code is a commonly used coding and decoding method in PLC. In contrast to Turbo, we investigate the bit error rate (BER) performance of Low Density Parity Check (LDPC) versus Turbo, while taking into account the scenarios of different codeword lengths, channel paths, the impacts of diverse noise patterns. A low-voltage PLC system with LDPC-OFDM and Turbo-OFDM is simulated for analyzing and comparing the performance of Turbo and LDPC code in PLCs. Finally, we proposed an adaptive coding and decoding approach for PLC over narrowband noise. Simulation results indicate that LDPC could be a viable alternative coding method for the next generation of PLC.

articleTitle: End-to-end Image Matting Based on Salient Portrait
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The aim of portrait fine segmentation is to accurately estimate the opacity of each pixel in the foreground of the portrait. At present, known methods often require auxiliary inputs that are difficult to obtain or multi-stage models with high computational cost, which cannot meet the application requirements of real-time. In order to have the advantages of both speed and precision, this paper designs a two-sided branch network structure (BIMNET) for single-stage real-time portrait segmentation. One of the two branches is used for detail prediction, and the edge detail feature map is generated by three nested U structures. The other is used for semantic prediction, which obtains high-level semantic features through a fast subsampling semantic path. Finally, the feature fusion module fuses the features of the two at different levels, and finishes the fine segmentation task with the guidance of three output levels. In order to reduce the extra inference cost and improve the robustness of the model, the multi-prediction output heads were designed only in the model training stage. In this paper, for the first time, a strategy combining bilateral network and fine segmentation is adopted to verify the effectiveness of single-stage real-time portrait segmentation, and the balance between precision and speed is achieved. In addition, we collect and annotate the portrait data as an extension of the training data, and all the data sets will be released.

articleTitle: Research on inconsistent consecutive DNS responses from DNS resolvers
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: As the core infrastructure of the Domain Name System (DNS), DNS resolvers play a vital role on the Internet. DNS responses are used for message transmission between DNS resolvers and clients. Their correctness and normalization directly affect whether clients can access the Internet safely and accurately. Therefore, the research on DNS responses returned by DNS resolvers is significant to ensure Internet security. We found that when some DNS resolvers received multiple consecutive identical DNS queries, they returned DNS responses with inconsistent headers. We believe that research on this phenomenon can provide a more comprehensive understanding of the behavior of DNS resolvers. This paper proposes a method to comprehensively discover the phenomenon by collecting and analyzing the DNS responses. In addition, this paper also proposes a method to verify our two speculations about the reasons for the phenomenon. The experimental results confirmed the credibility of one of the speculations that a specific configuration of the DNS resolvers caused them to add header sections with a specific meaning when responding to the DNS queries from the cache.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Anomaly Detection and Early Warning Issues
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: This article is a research on data-driven anomaly detection and early warning problems. Through the application of box plots, the time series data recorded by the instruments and equipment in the production area of a production company at 00:00:00-22:59:59 on a certain day (data disconnection has been carried out) Min) in the number of data fluctuations screening, the fluctuations in the data classified as risk of abnormal data and non-risk abnormal data, in conjunction with various major cause of changes in data fluctuations might weights event of heavy, abnormal level of risk of abnormal data conducted Quantitative evaluation, and early warning of risk abnormalities based on the gray prediction model, combined with the TOPSIS model, gives a solution to evaluate the safety of the entire production system of the enterprise. First, the sensor according to pre-processing time-series data to determine the relevant data occurs due to abnormal hormone. Use box plots to find outliers in data that change with time. After removing the sensor numbers whose data does not change with time, make scatter plots and box plots respectively to find outliers and outliers. The outliers are deduplicated and the time number is reversed. Secondly, a strong correlation table is created and the index change rate is calculated. After distinguishing and judging the risk and non-risk abnormal values, the location of the abnormal points is indexed and determined. Second, use the entropy method to calculate the weight of each indicator twice, and obtain the value (evaluation object) of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{m}\ (\mathrm{m}=100)$</tex> sensor numbers from the known data, n time (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{n}=5519$</tex>)) Is a matrix of evaluation indicators, and then standardizes and calculates the redundancy of information entropy, and then obtains the weight of each indicator at different times. On the basis of the weighted data obtained at different times, the degree of abnormality of the risky abnormal data is converted into a percentile system to score, and the ranking is performed using Excel, so as to realize the quantitative evaluation of the risky abnormal data. Third, use the abnormal degree of risky abnormal data as an indicator to establish a prediction model for the degree of risky abnormality in the production process, and use the historical data of the degree of risky abnormality to substitute into the data risk abnormal value evaluation system of question two to establish a preliminary gray prediction The model uses cubic spline function interpolation to improve the accuracy of the prediction model, and further calculates the data with the largest deviation in each time period and its corresponding abnormal sensor number. Finally, according to the model results of question 2 and question 3, we can get the frequency of different deviation degree within the data range every half an hour within 00:00.00-23:59:59, based on question 2 The entropy weight method model obtains the relative weights of the corresponding indicators, and at the same time considers the non-risk abnormal conditions, establishes a TOPSIS comprehensive evaluation model, and obtains the safety score of the enterprise production system. By comparing the change trend of the comprehensive score, describe the situation of the entire enterprise production system and observe the change relationship between various indicators. Verify that the conclusions obtained are accurate.

articleTitle: Scheduling and Routing Synthesis for Off-Chip Time-Triggered Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the increasing data processing ability of System-on-Chip (SoC), real-time systems are more and more implemented by off-chip interconnection architecture, which is small in size. Meanwhile, real-time applications demand time-triggered communication. Therefore, it is important to find a routing and scheduling approach for time-triggered messages in off-chip interconnection architecture. To achieve trade-offs between the cost of routing and scheduling while meeting the requirements of Time-Triggered Ethernet (TTE) is the main challenge for real-time communication. In this paper, we propose a scheduling and routing synthesis using an immune algorithm that is suitable for off-chip interconnection architecture. Given a set of time-triggered messages and the topology of the off-chip network, this approach is able to provide feasible routing and scheduling solutions which guarantee the schedulability of messages in off-chip time-triggered communication. Evaluation results show that the proposed approach can ensure the schedulability of all messages when the load of the network reaches 0.9, and achieves a significant improvement in runtime compared with approaches that do not consider synthesized optimization.

articleTitle: Research on Key Techniques of Text Recognition under Strong Light Noise
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Text recognition technology based on deep learning has achieved great success in recent years. However, these recognition models have poor robustness under the influence of strong light noise. The existing solution to this problem leverages preprocessing methods to remove uneven lighting, which shows just passable effects on noise reduction for strong light. In this paper, we propose a text image recognition algorithm with attention-based strong light region perception module to solve this problem. The model is trained to detect strong light regions and guide the generated feature maps to focus on the clear part of the input image. Experimental results show that this model mitigates the impact of strong light noise pollution and improves the robustness of recognition technology on multiple datasets.

articleTitle: Multi-dimensional Attention UNet with Variable Size Convolution Group for Road Segmentation in Remote Sensing Imagery
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The information extraction of high-resolution remote sensing images is an increasingly important part in essential urban planning, geological survey, and disaster monitoring. High-resolution feature information helps us quickly understand the arrangement of ground targets in an area. This article proposes a model called MDAUNet with multi-dimensional attention module, based on different dimensional information of road feature maps for attention. Besides, we use a variable size convolution group (VCG) module in resnet embedded to obtain better road representation. At the same time, to obtain road feature information at different levels in the decoding part, we adopt the dense connection of the decoding part to optimize the feature map of the decoding part. Our proposed road multi-dimensional information attention network has achieved superior performance on the Ottawa road dataset and CHN-CUG road dataset, its performance far exceeds the national art level.

articleTitle: Deep Graph Learning on Bipartite Observed Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In real-world settings, network structure observations are often incomplete due to the difficulties of data collection. However, most existing network analysis methods assume that the whole underlying structure is observed. In this paper, we focus on a common but overlooked network observation, named bipartite observation. We systematically study the influence of bipartite observations, and give an analytical representation using the stochastic block model. Moreover, we propose a new framework LP-GNN, which combines link prediction, sparsification, and graph neural networks for node classification tasks in bipartite observations. The effectiveness of LP-GNN is illustrated by experimental results on real datasets.

articleTitle: Optimal configuration method of fault location device in low voltage distribution network based on participation
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: The fault line segment location is a difficult problem of a low-voltage distribution network due to the short line segment length, a large number of line branches and complex field conditions. Moreover, the scheme that deploying a fault monitoring device at each node is impractical due to limited equipment investment. It is of practical significance to study the method of optimal configuration of fault location devices in low-voltage active distribution networks. In this paper, fault monitoring devices installed at the line section switches or tie switches are employed to monitor fault current information, and the number of the head end of each feeder line involved in a fault occurring in each feeder section is counted to calculated the node participation degree. The objective function of the optimal monitoring device configuration is built by comprehensively considering the overall participation and the uniformity of the monitoring units, and the economic constraint is considered. The device optimization configuration model is solved using the BPSO-GA algorithm. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by multiple simulations. The proposed method can effectively ensure the accuracy of fault location in low-voltage active distribution network, and improve the reliability and economy of low-voltage distribution network operation.

articleTitle: A Music Recommendation Algorithm Based on Convolutional Neural Network Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: With the advancement of digital multimedia technology, music libraries are growing in size and music resources are getting more plentiful, making it difficult for consumers to easily obtain the songs they want in the music world. For this phenomenon, personalized music recommendation systems have emerged. However, although there are many kinds of existing music recommendation systems, the recommendation effects are uneven, and there are some problems. This study offers a music recommendation algorithm based on neural networks, and conducts systematic experiments to create a network model structure based on a conventional convolutional neural network model, as well as compare and choose model training tuning parameters. Finally, the model is trained and evaluated, and the suggested quality assessment indices are the root mean square error, accuracy, recall, and F1 value. The results of the experiments suggest that the recommendation algorithm presented in this work is both feasible and effective. Unlike other traditional music recommendation algorithms, this paper takes full advantage of deep neural networks' powerful advantage of automatically extracting features and obtaining higher-level music feature representations from audio content while incorporating information on users' historical behavior toward music interactions, effectively solving problems like cold start in recommendation systems.

articleTitle: Research on Video Captioning Method Based on Semantic Key Frame
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: At present, in most video captioning models, when extracting video key frames, the extracted video key frames not only contain a lot of redundancy resulting video frame features with small diversity, but also ignore the video semantic information. Due to the neglect of such uniqueness, a semantic based video key frame method is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the initial video frames are extracted by combining the depth convolution network(CNN) and feature windowing. Secondly, this paper proposes to use the image captioning network to annotate the video frames and find the video key frames according to the semantic information. This method extracts the video key frames with more diversity and low redundancy. Then, we extracts the spatial, dynamic and regional features of the video to capture the potential context information in the video. Finally, we propose a pre-interactive LSTM model to effectively integrate text features, video features and context features, so as to solve the problem of context information loss and improve the annotation performance. Through the comparative experiment on MSR-VTT datasets, the results show that the proposed method improves by 1.2, 0.2, 0.1, 0.3 and 1.5 compared with the baseline model in terms of BLEU4, METEOR, ROUGE-L and CIDEr respectively, the MSVD datasets is improved by 2.2, 0.5, 0.4 and 4.4, which effectively improves the performance of video captioning.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Distribution Network Intelligent Gateway and Visual Monitoring Platform Based on Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Firstly, this paper investigates and analyzes the overall requirements of intelligent transformation and management of intelligent power distribution room, classifies the power distribution room equipment, then studies the standard modular power distribution room intelligent gateway which integrates routing+switching+computing power, and finally studies the visual panoramic monitoring system of distribution network equipment and environmental state. The research results of this paper can realize multi-dimensional condition monitoring and predictive maintenance of distribution room, which is of great significance to reduce operation and maintenance costs, improve power supply quality and improve power customer satisfaction. It can significantly improve the lean management level of distribution network and improve the operation level and social image of power grid enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on relation extraction method of contract text based on BERT
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: Entity recognition and relation extraction techniques in text mining are very important for the extraction of sensitive information in contract texts. Due to the lack of corpus in the field of contract texts, and the existing entity relation extraction models cannot extract relationships based on the semantics of contract texts. In view of the above problems, in order to enable the relation extraction model to apply the domain characteristics and domain knowledge of the contract domain, this paper proposes a joint entity-relation extraction method that integrates the representation of contract features, and incorporates the dictionary features into the model encoder part through the self-attention mechanism. The experimental results show that the learning of entity relationship information interaction and the introduction of the fusion contract type feature encoder can effectively improve the model performance.

articleTitle: Detection on Safety Helmet Wearing of Distribution Network Construction Based on YOLOv5-Btri Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 2nd Asia-Pacific Conference on Communications Technology and Computer Science (ACCTCS)
abstract: In order to monitor whether workers wear helmets correctly on the distribution network construction, and to address the problems of low detection accuracy of existing helmet detection, a new method based on YOLOv5s-Btri model was proposed in this paper. Firstly, the C3 module is improved by replacing the general convolution with improved Ghost convolution, to reduce the parameters. Secondly, the algorithm introduces the Triplet Attention to improve the C3 module, so as to improve the ability of feature extraction. At last, the PANet of the original network is improved by using BiFPN, thus obtaining richer location and semantic information. Fourthly, chooses CIOU as the loss function of the frame regression. The experimental results show that compared with YOLOv5s, the average detection accuracy of YOLOv5s-Btri network reaches 93.9%, which is improved by 2.9%.
